_doc: Conform & finishing for composite.py. Cut frames come from timing/shots.json (cut_f0 of the incoming shot).
A transition of N frames centred on the cut covers [cut - N//2 + offset, cut - N//2 + offset + N); both shots
must have those frames (6 handle frames each side), composite.py checks and clamps.
Types: cut | dissolve | light (additive bloom-flash crossfade) | colormatch (luma-led dissolve) |
luma (incoming highlights lead) | zoom (scale-up + radial blur zoom-through) | defocus (rack-focus dissolve; 'radius' = peak disk radius px at 1080 wide, default 18) |
dip (through black). 'flash' scales the light dissolve's exposure bloom; the bloom is further capped per frame
so the mix keeps texture (display p1 <= p1_cap 0.78, median <= p50_cap 0.88).
grade: per-shot trims in scene-linear light, neutral by default: exposure (stops), temp (+ = warmer,
~mired-like units, 10 = subtle), tint (+ = magenta), sat (1 = neutral), contrast (1 = neutral, pivot 0.18);
head {exposure, hold, frames}: an incoming-shot head exposure ramp - 'exposure' stops from the shot's first frame on
screen (incl. its incoming transition) for 'hold' frames, then eased to 0 over the next 'frames' frames.
keys [{f0, f1, gain: [r, g, b]}, ...]: colour keys, per-channel gains in linear light applied to the plate before the
other trims (absolute frames): full gain at f0, eased (smoothstep) to none at f1 (w = 1 - smoothstep((f - f0) / (f1 - f0)),
gain 1 + w * (gain - 1)); no effect before f0 or from f1 on. For a colour step inside a shot (a render setting that
changes at a chunk boundary): the gain puts the first frame of the new chunk on the colour trend of the frames before
it, and the ease spreads the step over f0..f1. Tune on the composited --no-overlays stills (CIELAB D65 of the frame's mean colour
at f0 vs the linear trend of the 5 frames before it, within 0.7 dE); re-tune whenever either side of the seam is re-rendered.
